build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && cd app && npm install && NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=4096' npm run build

deploy.startCommand: if [ "${BREADTH_V2_PRODUCER_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.breadth_v2_producer_main; elif [ "${TERMINAL_NEXT_MONITOR_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.terminal_next_monitor_main --once "${MONITOR_JOB:-ticking}"; elif [ "${BARS_API_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.bars_api_main; elif [ "${FLOW_WORKER_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.flow_worker_main; elif [ "${WORKER_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.worker_main; elif [ "${ECON_SERVICE_ENABLED:-0}" = "1" ]; then exec python -m api.econ_main; else exec uvicorn api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT --proxy-headers --forwarded-allow-ips='*' --timeout-graceful-shutdown 5; fi
